subject: Adaptive burst rate amendment request — OpsFlow temporary uplift
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@opsflow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@opsflow.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in inference volume — short uplift request

Kim,

Quick note — we saw an unexpected product rollout last weekend that doubled inference traffic against our current Redwood quota starting Saturday. The team expects the elevated level to persist for ~10–14 days while we finish throttling rules. Can Redwood provide a temporary rate/quota uplift to avoid 429s for customer-facing flows?

Two questions: 1) what is the cost for a 2-week uplift? 2) do you offer any credit/discount if we convert the uplift into a committed plan afterward?

I've attached a short export of July usage and the July->Aug spike (opsflow_usage_report_July2026.csv) for reference. Procurement – looping you in to capture next steps if this needs a PO.

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Head of Platform, OpsFlow
hannah.li@opsflow.com

Attachment: opsflow_usage_report_July2026.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@opsflow.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference volume — short uplift request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the heads up and for the usage export 1. We can definitely help avoid 429s while you stabilize throttles. Proposed path (fastest):

- Temporary uplift: increase quota by 3x for 14 days starting as soon as you confirm.
- Pricing: temporary uplift billed at 1.8x your current rate (charged on overage tokens only).
- Offset: we can apply a one-time credit equal to 25% of the uplift overage if OpsFlow signs a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of uplift end.

If you prefer a direct discount instead of a credit, we can trade down the credit to a 10% upfront discount on the uplift billing (same 14-day window).

Next steps: tell me which option you prefer and Ill queue the uplift. I can also schedule a 20-min call to walk procurement through the amendment flow (DocuSign link to follow once internal approvals are done). Attached is a short pricing summary (proposed-burst-pricing-v1.pdf).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: proposed-burst-pricing-v1.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

Rishi / Adi,

Forwarding OpsFlow ask. They want a 14-day uplift; my proposed commercial is 1.8x rate with 25% convert-to-commit credit. Quick asks:

- Finance sign-off on the 25% credit (one-time) if they convert to a 6-month commit within 30 days.
- Is there a standard legal amendment we should use for a temporary uplift (monica, can you pull the uplift clause language)?

Ive attached the usage export and the pricing summary. OpsFlow is mid-market, strong technical buyer 1 I'd like to keep this fast and reduce friction for procurement.

Thanks,
Kim

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Spike in inference volume — short uplift request

Kim,

Approve in principle. A couple of suggestions to reduce revenue risk: instead of a flat 25% credit, propose a tiered rebate:

- If OpsFlow signs a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days -> 25% rebate on uplift overage (applied as credit across next invoice).
- If OpsFlow signs a 3-month commit -> 12% rebate.
- If no commit within 30 days -> no rebate, uplift billed at 1.8x.

Also limit the maximum credit to the uplift overage amount (no negative invoices) and require DocuSign-signed amendment before uplift starts (we can pre-authorize the uplift contingent on DocuSign). Monica, can you draft amendment-draft-v2.pdf with the canary-conversion clause and the 30-day convert window? I'll route to finance for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Aug 28, 2026 at 11:30 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@opsflow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@opsflow.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@opsflow.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference volume — short uplift request (redlines)

Kim,

Thanks 1 we appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement here 1 a couple of redlines from our side on the amendment:

- Cap: we need an absolute cap on uplift spend so our finance team can predict exposure (can we set a hard cap equal to 1.5x July monthly spend for the uplift window?).
- SLA: we need a 99.9% availability clause or a credit table for downtime during the uplift window.
- Billing: request that any rebate/credit is applied as a direct invoice reduction (rather than a credit that expires).

Attaching a tracked-changes file with our redlines (opsflow_redlines.docx). If you can route an updated amendment via DocuSign we can turn this around quickly.

Regards,
Miguel Torres
VP Engineering, OpsFlow
miguel.torres@opsflow.com

Attachment: opsflow_redlines.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference volume — short uplift request (final path)

Miguel / Hannah,

Thanks for the redlines. Weve consumed OpsFlow's asks and can confirm the following final path to unblock traffic today: 

1) Uplift window: 14 days starting immediately upon signed amendment.
2) Pricing: uplift billed at 1.8x baseline rate during the window.
3) Cap: uplift spend will be capped at 1.5x your July monthly spend (per your request).
4) Conversion rebate: 25% rebate on uplift overage if OpsFlow signs a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of uplift end; 12% rebate for a 3-month commit. Rebate applied as invoice-level reduction (not an expiring credit). Maximum rebate limited to actual uplift charges.
5) SLA: we will include a 99.9% availability commitment for the uplift window; any uptime breach will be credited per the standard SLA table.

Next steps: Monica will upload the revised amendment (amendment-draft-v2.pdf updated with your redlines) and Ill circulate a DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/OPSF-8421/amendment. Please sign so we can flip the switch.

If you want a brief 15-minute kickoff after signing to sync rollout timing, Ill schedule with your engineering ops lead.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
